name: Power Purchase Agreement (Commercial)
description: A long-term contract under which a business or utility buys the output of a wind, solar or other generating facility. The checks read for the term and the date it starts, the price and how it changes, the delivery point, who gets the renewable energy credits, a commitment on output and the cost of curtailment, and credit support. The solar contract a household signs for its own roof has a type of its own.
compliance_matrix_columns: The term, and the date it starts running
The price, and how it changes
The delivery point, and who bears losses before it
Who gets the renewable energy credits
A commitment on output, and what curtailment costs
